[[Violent Night Event|Violent Night]] |first_wave_appearance = 7 |tab_1 = Event |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]45 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Below Average (2.8) |spawned_by = [[Snow Golem (Cold Ambush)|Snow Golem]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Snowman''' was an enemy that exclusively appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. Currently, it can appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had a below average speed, but it had a high amount of health. The '''Snowman''' could be spawned by the [[Snow Golem (Cold Ambush)|Snow Golem]], which could make it a big threat early on. ==Appearance== The '''Snowman''' is mainly made out of snow. Its rig has a waist. On its head there is an orange carrot and two black pebbles, which resembles eyes and a nose. On its torso, it has two large black pebble-buttons. There is also a slightly smaller pebble-button on its waist. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Cold Ambush]] is listed instead. *Towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Cowboy]], [[Golden Cowboy]], [[Militant]] or [[Crook Boss]] can take these down easily early on. **By the time [[Snow Golem (Cold Ambush)|Snow Golem]]s spawn, stronger towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended to fend off against them. *As these enemies spawn in large numbers, towers capable of damaging multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Executioner]] and the [[Mortar]] can be useful against this. **This can be especially useful against the '''Snowmen''' spawned by the [[Snow Golem (Cold Ambush)|Snow Golem]]s, as three spawn when a [[Snow Golem (Cold Ambush)|Snow Golem]] is defeated. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSnowman.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- 🎄 Christmas Trailer 🎄|'''Snowman''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ViolentNightSnowmanIconIG.png|'''Snowman''' on its icon. }} ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Snowman''' added. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Snowman''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Snowman''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Snowman]]'s from [[Operation I.C.E Event]] [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. **{{Bug}} Has no health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bugfix}} '''Snowman''' no longer breaks, as it now has health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{ColdAmbush|[[Gingerbread (Cold Ambush)|Gingerbread]]|Wave 5|Snowman|Wave 7|[[Snow Golem (Cold Ambush)|Snow Golem]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Snowman}}
